text: Flashfrost Enclave is an area found in the Waking Shores, just west of the Flashfrost Assault. It is a massive ice-covered chasm, likely formed by the Primalists and their elemental allies. It serves as their base of operations for their attack on the Ruby Life Pools and hosts large numbers of Primalists and infused proto-dragons under the command of Jadzigeth. Primalists perform numerous rituals within, some of which seek to infuse dragon eggs with elemental energy. When Basrikron (quest) is active, Basrikron will appear on the cliffs above the enclave.
Flashfrost Incursion is an area found in the Ruby Life Pools.

Flarendo's Biggest Fan is awarded to players who defeat the Cauldron of Carnage while being Flarendo's Biggest Fan in Liberation of Undermine on Normal difficulty or higher. To accomplish this, speak with the Flaming Megafan just outside the last trash pack before the arena. Then defeat Professor Boomspark before defeating King Flamespite . This will put an untimed buff on all players who spoke with the Flaming Megafan: :. Defeat the encounter with this buff active to earn the achievement. Dying will remove the buff, so be careful! For the sibling achievement, Torq's Biggest Fan, reverse the process by speaking with the Thundering Megafan and defeating King Flamespite first. Only one of thes

Footmen are a melee ground unit of the Alliance family in Warcraft Rumble. Though they are not cheap, they have high health and decent damage, as well as coming in a squad. As a result, if used properly, they can overwhelm a lane quickly. Their slow movement makes them susceptible to ranged attacks and area of effect spells or attacks. A squad of footmen is made up of four members.

s and the NPC teammates in .]] Follower Dungeons are a type of dungeon party introduced in patch 10.2.5, accessed from the Dungeon Finder or by speaking with an NPC by the dungeon entrance. Instead of being queued with other players, your party will be filled with up to four NPC followers, depending on your group's initial size. Therefore, queuing into Follower Dungeons is always instant. The system is currently available for , , and normal dungeons. Rewards are the same as they would be in normal difficulty. A maximum of 50 Follower Dungeons can be started per day per account.

Foraging Pangos are pangos found throughout Zul'Aman. They roam forest areas, occasionally stopping to dig next to rocks or plants or lying down to sleep. Juvenile Pangos are usually located near them.

Forbidden Tomes are found at various spots at the Banewood in Revendreth when Scrivener Lenua is up. Four of them have to be carried to the Forbidden Library in order to summon her. While carrying them, occasionally Enticed Mites will spawn and attack the player.
